answer: Route every newcomer through one guarded inlet: an already-established sponsor who posts a timber-heavy bond and co-signs joint liability for the recruit. Fail a random audit later and both the recruit and the sponsor's bond are slashed down to the walnut. Honest sponsors are scarce and each can back only a few before its own stake runs dry, so a sybil fleet cannot mint masks freely — every fake demands a real sponsor with capital at risk, and attack cost scales with the sponsors you must burn.
